# Loyola Law School

> Loyola Law School in downtown Los Angeles is a Jesuit institution offering JD, LLM, and MLS degrees with distinctive strengths in entertainment law, social justice, and experiential learning.

Loyola Law School (LLS), part of Loyola Marymount University, combines rigorous legal education with a commitment to social justice and public interest law. The school is known for its top-ranked entertainment law program, innovative BUILT initiative in business and technology law, and extensive clinical opportunities serving underrepresented communities.

## Key Topics

- Experiential Learning
- Clinical Programs
- Social Justice
- Entertainment Law
- Public Interest Law
- Juris Doctor (JD)
- Legal Clinics
- Criminal Justice
- Immigrant Justice
- Advocacy Programs
- Center for Juvenile Law & Policy

- Concentrations & Specializations
